name: Nishiazabu Taku
lunchNoteZh: 壽司主廚精選・僅週六
lunchNoteJa: 鮨おまかせ・土曜のみ

menus.name: Omakase course
menus.note: About 20 pieces of tsumami and sushi; the same course at Saturday lunch; including tax and service

bookingOpens: Online only, through OMAKASE, which the restaurant's own site links to. The course is paid in advance, and a booking stands only once the restaurant has confirmed it.
groups: The whole restaurant can be booked for up to 20 guests. Besides the eight-seat main counter there are two six-seat counters, one in a private room and one in an annex nearby; seats can't be chosen when booking.
byob: Wine only, with corkage of ¥3,300 a bottle.
